levels.surface: أبو سليمان أحمد بن هوذة أبي هراسة الباهلي
أبو محمد عبد الله بن حماد الأنصاري

notes: «يرفعه» marks the raising of the report to its source, which the text does not name: an unnamed link at that point (rule 8), not filled. The Prophet is the end and is not written.
The years («سنة ثلاث وسبعين ومائتين» etc.) are dates, not names: left out. The saying is Jibril's report to the Prophet inside the narrative: no transmitter is written for it.
